scripts.text: We would like to inform that the Hunter Job Change Location
has been moved to ^ff0000Hugel^000000 in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 修瓦尔茨巴尔德共和国的^ff0000毁葛^000000。

scripts.text: You can now use the Hugel airline, so please use the airship to visit Hugel.
scripts.translation: 现在可以使用毁葛航线了，请乘坐飞空艇前往毁葛。

scripts.text: You will find the new Job Change Location at ^ff0000 Hugel 208 222 ^000000.
^804000(You found a tiny line written at the end of the notice.)^000000
scripts.translation: ^804000（你在告示末尾发现了一行小字。）^000000

scripts.text: I, the Falcon breeder have moved out as well.
scripts.translation: 我，猎鹰饲养员，也搬走了。

scripts.text: Oh, how have you been? It's been a long time, hasn't it?
scripts.translation: 哦，最近怎么样？好久不见了吧？

scripts.text: Oops! I'm sorry, I could have sworn that we've met before. Huh. How weird.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！抱歉，我还以为我们以前见过呢。真奇怪。

scripts.text: Eh? You haven't had enough training as an Archer yet. To become a Hunter, you must gain a certain level of experience as an Archer first.
scripts.translation: 咦？你作为弓箭手，修行还不够。想成为猎人，得先积累足够的弓箭手经验。

scripts.text: Go out and train yourself a bit more. You'll need to be at least Job Level 40 before you'll be ready to become a Hunter. Of course, you can train more than that if you want.
scripts.translation: 再去多练练吧。职业等级至少达到40级，才能转职为猎人。当然，你愿意的话，也可以练到更高的等级。

scripts.text: You can't change jobs without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before applying to change jobs~
scripts.translation: 技能点没用完，是不能转职的。申请转职前，请先用完所有技能点~

scripts.text: a Novice? Wow, you've got a long way ahead of you. I don't think there's much you can do here.
scripts.translation: 初心者吧？哇，前面的路还很长呢。这里恐怕没什么能帮上你的。

scripts.text: You have chosen the path of the sword. I can respect the strength of your blade. Of course, from far away, you can't really afford to throw your sword at enemies, can you?
scripts.translation: 你选择了用剑的道路，我也认可剑的威力。不过，敌人离得远的时候，总不能把剑扔过去吧？

scripts.text: You deal with magic? It must feel great to be able to wield mystic power.
scripts.translation: 你使用魔法？能驾驭神秘力量一定很棒吧。

scripts.text: Oh, a person who serves God! Nice to meet you. There aren't many people like you that visit this place~ Hehe.
scripts.translation: 哦，是侍奉神明的人！很高兴见到你。像你这样的人，很少来这里呢~呵呵。

scripts.text: This place doesn't have anything worth stealing or anyone worth killing!!
scripts.translation: ！这里没有什么值得偷的东西，也没有值得杀的人！！

scripts.text: Phew...sometimes it is really hard for being a hunter, you know...
scripts.translation: 呼...当猎人有时也挺辛苦的，你知道吧..

scripts.text: So how do you like your bohemian life? Yeah, I am envious of you for having so much freedom...
scripts.translation: .你那无拘无束的生活过得怎么样？真羡慕你能那么自由...

scripts.text: Long time no see~ What brings you here? Did your Falcon run away or something?
scripts.translation: ！！好久不见~什么风把你吹来了？该不会是猎鹰跑了吧？

scripts.text: I don't really have any official notices from the guild at the moment, so I hope you didn't come here just for that...
scripts.translation: 我目前并没有收到公会的正式通知，希望你不是专门为了这个才来的...

scripts.text: Hmm... I've been informed that you passed the test. But you don't have the necessary 'Necklace of Wisdom (Penetration)' that proves your accomplishment.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我听说你通过了测试。但你没有带来证明合格的“慧眼（穿透）”。

scripts.text: I'll let you change your job, but you must bring back a 'Necklace of Wisdom (Penetration),' no matter what it takes.
scripts.translation: 我可以让你转职，但无论如何，你都必须带回“慧眼（穿透）”。

scripts.text: You look great as a Hunter!!
Become a noble person and become a worthy representative of our Hunter Guild. Show your love of nature as a Hunter~
scripts.translation: 要做个品格高尚的人，成为无愧于猎人公会的代表。用猎人的行动，展现你对自然的热爱吧~

scripts.text: And also, here is a little reward for all the effort you put in. It's from me, of course~
scripts.translation: 还有，这是给你的小小奖励，感谢你付出的努力。当然，是我个人送的~

scripts.text: Oh, you're an Archer! It seems as if you've trained enough as an Archer... You came here to become a Hunter, right?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是弓箭手！看来已经修行得差不多了...你是来转职为猎人的吧？

scripts.text: Yes. That's what I'm here for.
What are the requirements to change jobs?
I was right! Let me put you on the candidate list. Let's see~*
scripts.translation: ~我猜对了！让我把你登记到候选名单上。看看~*

scripts.text: Hmm... Let's start with the interview. Wait and relax a moment. No need to worry, I'll prepare everything~
scripts.translation: 嗯...先从面试开始吧。稍等一下，放轻松。别担心，我会准备好一切的~

scripts.text: Here they are: the interview questions~ First of all, my name is 'Sherin.' Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation: ！找到了，面试题目~先自我介绍一下，我叫谢琳。很高兴见到你！

scripts.text: Listen carefully to the scenarios I describe. When I ask a question, you choose an answer. Pretty simple, don't you think?
scripts.translation: 仔细听我描述的情境，等我提问时选一个答案。很简单吧？

scripts.text: I just want to know how you think about life, and why you want to become a Hunter, so there's no need to be nervous.
scripts.translation: 我只是想了解你对生活的看法，以及想成为猎人的理由，不用紧张。

scripts.text: You must bring all of the items that will be requested by the guild. You can worry about that later.
scripts.translation: ...带齐公会要求的物品。这件事可以之后再考虑。

scripts.text: You've gotta pass the test administered by the guild. If you have had enough training as an Archer, you should be able to pass the test~
scripts.translation: ...通过公会的测试。只要你作为弓箭手的修行足够，应该就能通过~

scripts.text: Well, let's start with the interview. This time, carefully think about the answers to each question.
scripts.translation: ..！好，开始面试吧。这次要仔细思考每一道题的答案哦。

scripts.text: You are an Archer, and you don't know where you should go to hunt. What do you do?
scripts.translation: 你是一名弓箭手，却不知道该去哪里狩猎。你会怎么做？

scripts.text: Scream out loud asking where you should go.
Quietly ask a person passing by.
Wander around alone and search for a place.
So you've decided on a place to hunt. You're going to hunt the monsters known as Hodes in the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation: 你选好了狩猎地点，打算去苏克拉特沙漠猎杀蚯蚓。

scripts.text: How do you go to the desert?
Ask a Priest to open a free warp portal.
scripts.translation: 请牧师免费开启传送之阵

scripts.text: There is no Priest to ask for a warp, and no friend is around to walk with you. You must use the Kafra service, but you have no Zeny!
scripts.translation: 你找不到能帮忙传送的牧师，也没有朋友能陪你走过去。只能使用卡普拉服务，可你没有Zeny！

scripts.text: Sell items I do not need.
So you finally arrive at the Sograt Desert. But you realize that Hodes are a bit too strong for you to hunt alone.
scripts.translation: 你终于来到苏克拉特沙漠，却发现蚯蚓太强，一个人不太好对付。

scripts.text: Attack a Hode from the top of a hill.

scripts.translation: 攻击别人正在打的蚯蚓

scripts.text: Let's say you were having too much trouble hunting Hodes and returned to town. Now you are out of HP and a Priest happens to be around. How would you ask for a Heal?
scripts.translation: 假设你觉得蚯蚓太难打，便回到了城镇。现在你的HP已经见底，正好附近有位牧师。你会怎么请对方施放治愈术？

scripts.text: Would it be possible to get a Heal, please?
scripts.translation: 请问可以为我施放治愈术吗？

scripts.text: This time, you found a rare item while you were going through your inventory. You go out to sell the item, and there are many people with stores and chatrooms open.
scripts.translation: 这次，你整理物品栏时发现了一件稀有物品。你想把它卖掉，出去后看到许多人在摆摊、开聊天室。

scripts.text: Scream out loud to everyone in sight.
scripts.translation: 大声向周围所有人喊话

scripts.text: Look to see if anyone already wants it.
While you are waiting, someone is begging for items and Zeny. What should you do?
scripts.translation: 在等待期间，有人正在乞讨物品和Zeny。你应该怎么做？

scripts.text: Give some of my items and Zeny.
Tell the person about a good place to hunt.
scripts.translation: 告诉对方一个适合狩猎的地方

scripts.text: By now, you decide to go to the Maze by yourself.
scripts.translation: 现在，你决定独自前往迷宫。

scripts.text: But on your way, you run
Tell them which way to go.
After meeting this lost person, you decide to get back to hunting. Just then, you find that someone is attacking a boss!
scripts.translation: 遇到那个迷路的人后，你决定继续狩猎。这时，你发现有人正在打首领！

scripts.text: Watch, then attack when asked for help.
scripts.translation: 先观望，等对方求助再出手

scripts.text: You are now very exhausted after your day of hunting. It's time to go back to town.
scripts.translation: 狩猎了一整天，你已经很累，该回城了。

scripts.text: But what's this!? You find an expensive item lying on the floor! What should you do with it?
scripts.translation: 咦，这是什么！？你发现地上有件贵重物品！你会怎么处理？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
Okay, this is the end of the test!
Well done! Your answers show you've got the right outlook on life. You definitely have the right qualities to become a Hunter~
scripts.translation: 答得很好！你的回答表明你有正确的人生观。你确实具备成为猎人的素质~

scripts.text: I'm glad to say you've passed the interview~ Now, go to that person in the corner and confirm which item is necessary for your job change test~
scripts.translation: 很高兴告诉你，面试通过了~去找角落里那个人，确认转职测试需要哪些物品吧~

scripts.text: Well, I'm looking at your answers and your score isn't perfect. But I'll let you pass anyway. I don't know what our Guildmaster will think, though.
scripts.translation: 嗯，看了你的回答，成绩还不算完美。不过，还是让你通过吧。只是不知道会长会怎么想。

scripts.text: Just remember to always keep basic etiquette in mind. Try harder in the following tests and make me happy, okay?
scripts.translation: 记得时刻遵守基本礼仪。接下来的测试要更努力些，别让我失望哦？

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't think this'll work out. You can't become a Hunter without knowing basic etiquette.
scripts.translation: 嗯...这样可不行。不懂基本礼仪，是不能成为猎人的。

scripts.text: Think about how you answered the questions one more time. In order to value nature, you must first value your relationship with others.
scripts.translation: 再好好想想你是怎么回答那些问题的吧。想要珍视自然，首先得珍视你与他人的关系。

scripts.text: Then, you'll be more in tune with nature and with other people. It's this kind of harmony that makes the best Hunters.
scripts.translation: 这样，你才能与自然、与他人和谐相处。最优秀的猎人，正是懂得这种和谐的人。

scripts.text: Just give the item to the Demon Hunter, the guy who's all the way to the left in this area~
scripts.translation: 把物品交给恶魔猎人就行了，他就在这片区域最左边~

scripts.text: If you decide to become a Hunter, promise to come visit me. I want to see you as a Hunter. You would look great!!
scripts.translation: 决定成为猎人的话，要答应我回来看看哦。我想看看你成为猎人的样子，一定很帅！！

scripts.text: If you decide to become a Hunter, come and visit me, okay? You're pretty, but... You'd be even prettier as a Hunter. Hehe~
scripts.translation: 决定成为猎人的话，要回来看看哦？你已经很漂亮了，不过...穿上猎人的装束，会更漂亮。嘿嘿~

scripts.text: You weren't able to find the Demon Hunter? That guy is just to the left! Hehe~
scripts.translation: 你居然没找到恶魔猎人？那个人就在左边！嘿嘿~

scripts.text: I want to see you become a Hunter...! Waaah~ I think you'd look great, so please hurry!
scripts.translation: 我想看你成为猎人的样子...！哇~一定很帅，快去吧！

scripts.text: Hmm, I think you're supposed to visit someone else, not me. Like our Guildmaster who's out for business, you know?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你现在该找的不是我，而是别人。比如我们那位出差的会长。

scripts.text: I heard he's at the Payon Central Palace... Or in the Archer Village, one of those two places. Try visiting those places and find him, okay?
scripts.translation: 听说他在斐扬中央宫殿...或者弓箭手村，两处之一。去那里找找他吧？

scripts.text: Eh? You haven't trained enough as an Archer. To become a Hunter, you need to gain more experience as an Archer first.
scripts.translation: 咦？你作为弓箭手，修行还不够。想成为猎人，得先积累更多弓箭手经验。

scripts.text: Well then, go train some more. You must be at least Job Level 40 to be exact. Of course, you can always go higher. See you next time~
scripts.translation: 再去多练练吧。准确地说，职业等级至少要达到40级。当然，也可以练到更高。下次见~

scripts.text: Greetings. They call me... ^660000The Demon Hunter^000000. I am the one in charge of processing applications. Your name is ... {0}, correct?
scripts.translation: 你好，大家称我为……恶魔猎人。我负责受理申请。你的名字是……^660000{0}^000000，对吧？

scripts.text: Hehehe. I keep telling you, it's not~~
Leave if you plan to trifle me your petty tricks. Do you not realize that you are toying with ^660000The Demon Hunter^000000?!'
scripts.translation: 想耍这种小把戏，就给我滚出去。你不知道自己是在戏弄恶魔猎人吗？！ ^660000^000000

scripts.text: Okay. These are the items you need for the test. Since we provide all the arrows you will be using for this test, we need you to get the materials to make them.
scripts.translation: 好，测试需要这些物品。测试用的箭矢由我们提供，所以需要你收集制箭的材料。

scripts.text: You see, we're having some financial problems. Let's see, we're short on these items...
scripts.translation: 你也知道，我们最近手头有点紧。看看，还缺这些东西...

scripts.text: Hmm. ^660000{0} {1}^000000 to use for arrow tips. ^660000{2} {3}^000000 to use here and there. And ^660000{4} {5}^000000 please.
By the way, a member of our Hunter Guild is at the Archer Guild on official business. I believe you have to go visit this person since he is in charge of the testing.
scripts.translation: 顺便说一下，猎人公会有位成员正在弓箭手公会办事。他负责测试，你得去找他。

scripts.text: Oh right. Our Guildmaster has gone on an official trip to the Payon Central Palace. You have to go visit him because the one that administers the test.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，会长去斐扬中央宫殿办事了。他负责主持测试，你得去找他。他就在

scripts.text: You can find him in a building east of the Payon Central Palace.
scripts.translation: 斐扬中央宫殿东侧的一栋建筑里。

scripts.text: Alright then, come back to me when you have everything ready~
scripts.translation: 那么，等你准备好所有东西后再回来找我吧~

scripts.text: You brought all of the necessary materials... You can get directions to the testing area from our Guildmaster who is currently in the Payon Central Palace.
scripts.translation: 所需材料都带齐了...会长现在在斐扬中央宫殿，去问他测试场地怎么走吧。

scripts.text: You brought all of the necessary materials... To get directions to the testing area, go talk to our Guildmaster who is at the Archer Guild.
scripts.translation: 所需材料都带齐了...去弓箭手公会找会长，问他测试场地怎么走吧。

scripts.text: Hmm? You didn't go to the Guildmaster either in Payon Central Palace or at the Archer Guild? He should be at one of the two places, so go look for him.
scripts.translation: 嗯？还没去斐扬中央宫殿或弓箭手公会找会长？他应该在这两处之一，去找找吧。

scripts.text: Ooh. You passed the test. Congratulations~ You should go talk to Sherin now.
scripts.translation: 哦，通过测试了。恭喜~现在去找谢琳吧。

scripts.text: If you wish to change your job to a Hunter, you must register first.
scripts.translation: 想转职为猎人，得先登记。

scripts.text: Hmpf. You must be here for the Hunter job test. Let me tell you about the testing process. What would you like to know?
scripts.translation: 哼，你是来参加猎人转职测试的吧。我来说明测试流程，你想了解什么？

scripts.text: You have to hunt down certain monsters with a particular name. But you must avoid all the traps while you're at it.
scripts.translation: 你要猎杀指定名称的魔物，同时避开所有陷阱。

scripts.text: This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.
scripts.translation: 这项测试考验你在各种情况下迅速移动、找到目标的能力。

scripts.text: Within the time limit, starting in the 6 o'clock direction of the map, you must hunt the target monsters and then hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation: 在限定时间内，从地图的6点钟方向出发，猎杀目标魔物，再按下地图中央出现的逃脱开关。

scripts.text: You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map after you hit the switch.
scripts.translation: 按下开关后，从地图12点钟方向逃出去，就算通过。

scripts.text: Hmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start from the beginning. Also, only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation: 嗯，注意事项...一旦落入陷阱，就得从头再来。另外，一次只能有一个人参加测试。

scripts.text: I will send you to the testing place. There will be a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 我会把你送到测试场地，那里有候场室。如果有人正在测试，你必须在聊天室里等待。

scripts.text: If the person in front succeeds, resigns or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 前一个人通过、放弃或失败后，聊天室里的下一位就会被送进考场。如果没人排队，你进入聊天室后就会立即开始测试。

scripts.text: Okay. I'll send you to the testing area right now. Don't blame me if you get lost or confused because you didn't listen to my explanation.
scripts.translation: 好，现在就送你去考场。要是没听我的说明，到时迷路或不知所措，可别怪我。

scripts.text: Well, then. Your arrows are probably still being made, so you can use mine to take the test.
scripts.translation: 你的箭矢大概还没做好，测试时就先用我的吧。

scripts.text: I wasn't notified about anything in particular from the Hunter Guild. You're not trying to skip the middle part of the Hunter test, are you?
scripts.translation: 猎人公会没通知我有什么特别的事。你该不会想跳过猎人测试的中间环节吧？

scripts.text: Go gather the items for the test, and come back after you've visited the Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation: 去收集测试所需的物品，然后去猎人公会报到后再回来。

scripts.text: Hmm? Can I help you? If you wish to change jobs, you should visit the person at the Archer Guild, not me.
scripts.translation: 嗯？有什么事吗？如果你想转职，应该去弓箭手公会找负责的人，而不是我。

scripts.text: Hmm. You're the Archer that almost gave up on changing jobs. You do have everything ready, right? Then I'll send you to take the test right away.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你就是那个差点放弃转职的弓箭手。这次都准备好了吧？那我马上送你去参加测试。

scripts.text: You have to hunt down certain monsters with a particular name, but you also avoid all the traps at the same time. This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.
scripts.translation: 你要猎杀指定名称的魔物，同时避开所有陷阱。这项测试考验你在各种情况下迅速移动、找到目标的能力。

scripts.text: Within the given time, you will start at the 6 o'clock direction of the map, hunt the target monsters, and then hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation: 在限定时间内，从地图的6点钟方向出发，猎杀目标魔物，再按下地图中央出现的逃脱开关。

scripts.text: You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map after you hit the switch.
scripts.translation: 按下开关后，从地图12点钟方向逃出去，就算通过。

scripts.text: Hmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start from the beginning. Also, only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation: 嗯，注意事项...一旦落入陷阱，就得从头再来。另外，一次只能有一个人参加测试。

scripts.text: I'll send you to the testing place. There is a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 我会把你送到测试场地，那里有候场室。如果有人正在测试，你必须在聊天室里等待。

scripts.text: If the person in front succeeds, resigns or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 前一个人通过、放弃或失败后，聊天室里的下一位就会被送进考场。如果没人排队，你进入聊天室后就会立即开始测试。

scripts.text: Eh? Why won't I give you Silver Arrows? Don't expect anything when you don't bring any materials.
scripts.translation: 咦？问我为什么不给你银箭矢？没带材料，就别指望我给你什么。

scripts.text: Anyway, I believe you've prepared it yourself. Let's begin now.
scripts.translation: 总之，我相信你已经自己准备好了。开始吧。

scripts.text: Wow, you came back in one piece!
scripts.translation: 哇，你竟然完好无损地回

scripts.text: I mean, good job. I'll give you the item which proves that you have passed the test.
scripts.translation: 来了！我是说，干得好。给你一件物品，证明你通过了测试。

scripts.text: Okay, here it is. Now, go back to the Hunter Guild. I have some more business left to do here, but I hope you can become a Hunter soon.
scripts.translation: 好，拿着。回猎人公会去吧。我在这里还有些事要办，希望你能早日成为猎人。

scripts.text: I see you aren't in a hurry to become a Hunter? When I first became a Hunter, I ran around for a month wildly brandishing my bow because I was so happy. Hehe~
scripts.translation: 看来你不急着成为猎人？我刚转职那会儿，高兴得挥着弓到处乱跑，足足跑了一个月。呵呵~

scripts.text: Now, you should go back to the Hunter Guild~
scripts.translation: 现在，你应该回到猎人公会了~

scripts.text: I'm here for official business and am busy at the moment. If you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation: 么事吗？我在这里办公务，现在正忙，请见谅...

scripts.text: Mmm. I see you're here for the Hunter job test. Let me explain the testing process. What would you like to know?
scripts.translation: 嗯，看来你是来参加猎人转职测试的。我来说明测试流程，你想了解什么？

scripts.text: You have to hunt down certain monsters with a particular name, but you must avoid all of the traps here at the same time.
scripts.translation: 你要猎杀指定名称的魔物，同时避开这里的所有陷阱。

scripts.text: This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.
scripts.translation: 这项测试考验你在各种情况下迅速移动、找到目标的能力。

scripts.text: Within the given time, you will start in the 6 o'clock direction of the map, hunt the target monsters, and hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation: 从地图的6点钟方向出发，在限定时间内猎杀目标魔物，再按下地图中央出现的逃脱开关。

scripts.text: You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map when the switch is activated.
scripts.translation: 开关启动后，从地图12点钟方向逃出去，就算通过。

scripts.text: Mmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start the test over from the beginning. And only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation: 嗯，注意事项...一旦落入陷阱，就得从头再来。而且，一次只能有一个人参加测试。

scripts.text: I'll send you to the testing place. There is a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 我会把你送到测试场地，那里有候场室。如果有人正在测试，你必须在聊天室里等待。

scripts.text: If the person currently taking the test passes or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 正在测试的人通过或失败后，聊天室里的下一位就会被送进考场。如果没人排队，你进入聊天室后就会立即开始测试。

scripts.text: ...Okay. I'll send you to the testing area right now. Don't blame me if you get lost or confused because you didn't listen to the explanation.
scripts.translation: ...好，现在就送你去考场。要是没听说明，到时迷路或不知所措，可别怪我。

scripts.text: Well, your arrows are probably still being made, so you can use mine to take the test.
scripts.translation: 你的箭矢大概还没做好，测试时就先用我的吧。

scripts.text: I wasn't notified by the Hunter Guild about anything. You're not trying to skip the middle part of the Hunter test, are you?
scripts.translation: 猎人公会没通知我什么事。你该不会想跳过猎人测试的中间环节吧？

scripts.text: Stop by once you have gathered all the items needed for the test.
scripts.translation: 等你收集齐测试所需的所有物品后，再来找我。

scripts.text: If you wish to change jobs, I think you need to go visit the person at Payon Central Palace.
scripts.translation: 想转职的话，应该去斐扬中央宫殿找负责的人。

scripts.text: Mmm? Aren't you the Archer who gave up last time? Now you're ready, right? Then I'll send you to the job change area right now.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你不是上次放弃的弓箭手吗？这次准备好了吧？那我现在就送你去转职场地。

scripts.text: What are the requirements to pass the test?
scripts.translation: 通过测试的要求是什么？

scripts.text: You have to hunt down certain monsters with a particular name, but you must avoid all of the traps here at the same time.
scripts.translation: 你要猎杀指定名称的魔物，同时避开这里的所有陷阱。

scripts.text: This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.
scripts.translation: 这项测试考验你在各种情况下迅速移动、找到目标的能力。

scripts.text: Within the given time, you will start in the 6 o'clock direction of the map, hunt the target monsters, and hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation: 从地图的6点钟方向出发，在限定时间内猎杀目标魔物，再按下地图中央出现的逃脱开关。

scripts.text: You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map when the switch is activated.
scripts.translation: 开关启动后，从地图12点钟方向逃出去，就算通过。

scripts.text: Mmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start the test over from the beginning. And only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation: 嗯，注意事项...一旦落入陷阱，就得从头再来。而且，一次只能有一个人参加测试。

scripts.text: I'll send you to the testing place. There is a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 我会把你送到测试场地，那里有候场室。如果有人正在测试，你必须在聊天室里等待。

scripts.text: If the person currently taking the test passes or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation: 正在测试的人通过或失败后，聊天室里的下一位就会被送进考场。如果没人排队，你进入聊天室后就会立即开始测试。

scripts.text: Eh? Why don't I give you any Silver Arrows? Well, you shouldn't expect to get anything when you didn't even bring the materials.
scripts.translation: 咦？问我为什么不给你银箭矢？连材料都没带，就别指望我给你什么。

scripts.text: Wow. You're back in one piece!
I mean, good job. Well then, I'll give you the item which serves as proof that you passed the test.
scripts.translation: 地回来了！我是说，干得好。给你一件物品，证明你通过了测试。

scripts.text: Now hurry back to the Hunter Guild, and join us~
I see you're not in a hurry to become a Hunter. I was running around with joy, wildly brandishing my bow the first month I became a Hunter. Hehe~
scripts.translation: 看来你不急着成为猎人。我刚转职的第一个月，高兴得挥着弓到处乱跑。呵呵~

scripts.text: What do you want? I'm on an official trip and am busy at the moment. Now if you'll excuse me.
scripts.translation: 你想干什么？我正在出差，现在很忙。失陪了。

scripts.text: Good day. Welcome to the Hunter testing site. The test begins when you enter the next room.
scripts.translation: 你好，欢迎来到猎人测试场地。进入下一个房间，测试就会开始。

scripts.text: As explained before, hunt 4 or more of the monsters named ^3355FFJob change monster^000000. Upon doing so, a switch in the center of the map will then appear.
scripts.translation: 正如之前所说，你要猎杀至少4只名为转职魔物的魔物。完成后，地图中央会出现一个开关。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: When you destroy the switch, the exit will appear in the 12 o'clock direction of the map. Complete everything within the given time and escape.
scripts.translation: 破坏开关后，出口会出现在地图12点钟方向。请在规定时间内完成全部任务并逃出去。

scripts.text: If you faint in the middle, fall into a trap, or go over the time limit, you'll fail. Then you must then retake the test.
scripts.translation: 如果中途倒下、落入陷阱或超时，就算失败，必须重新参加测试。

scripts.text: We will provide the arrows, so just make sure that you bring a bow. Well, then. Please enter when you are ready.
scripts.translation: 我们会提供箭矢，你只需带好弓。准备好了就进去吧。

scripts.text: of your HP and SP for now.
If it's too hard, it wouldn't hurt to try again next time. Would you like to resign for now?
scripts.translation: 觉得太难的话，下次再试也无妨。要先放弃吗？

scripts.text: Okay. Do your best and become a great Hunter. Please enter the waiting room. If someone is already taking the test, you must wait until that person is done.
scripts.translation: 好，加油，争取成为一名优秀的猎人。请进入候场室。如果有人正在测试，必须等对方结束。

scripts.text: Very well. I'll send you to Payon. Hope to see you next time. Don't forget to save when you leave.
scripts.translation: 好，我送你回斐扬。希望下次还能见到你。离开时别忘了存档。

scripts.text: You shouldn't be here. How about finding the required job change item first?
scripts.translation: 你还不该来这里。先去找齐转职所需的物品吧？
